text:
Alex: Heads-up — spotted a microcopy + accessibility issue in the Cost breakdown tooltip when the panel is narrow. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/xx/tooltip-trunc.png :eyes: Marta: I can repro. On mobile/smaller panes the tooltip truncates with 'Estimated token usage for...' and there's no way for screen readers to get the rest. :a11y: Sam: Is this the small info icon next to 'Token estimate'? I remember it was designed to be one-liner, but the copy got longer in the latest pass. Kevin: Yep that's the one. Two problems: (1) visual truncation with ellipsis, (2) no accessible full text exposed — `title` alone isn't reliable for AT. Alex: Proposed options: 1) shorten tooltip copy to a concise sentence that fits two lines, 2) keep full copy but add a "Read more" link that opens a small modal, or 3) keep current text but ensure a full `aria-label`/`aria-describedby` exposes the full string to screen readers. Marta: I prefer option 1 for cognitive load, but we must keep the important bits: it's an estimate and includes both prompt+response tokens. Current draft: "Estimated token usage for input and output; actual tokens may vary based on generation length and truncation." Sam: That draft is wordy. What about: "Approximate tokens used (input + output). Actual usage may vary." Kevin: Short + clear is good. For accessibility, even if we shorten visually we should include the full explanatory sentence in an `aria-describedby` element. Example pattern we use elsewhere: ``` Estimated token usage for both input and output. This is an approximate value and actual token consumption may vary with generation length and truncation. ``` Marta: That SR-only pattern is fine. But two UX nits: (a) do we want the tooltip to wrap instead of truncating on narrow widths? (b) if we add a "Read more" link, does it need to be keyboard focusable inside the tooltip? Alex: Good points. I think tooltip should allow wrapping up to 240px width before truncating, to avoid unreadable tiny lines. If we add 'Read more' open an inline modal requiring focus management. Sam: Another microcopy question: the Undo action after toggling a setting currently says "Undo" in the toast. Should the toast include context like "Reverted model pin — Undo" vs just "Undo"? Screenshots: https://img.redwood.example/xx/toast.png Kevin: For accessibility and clarity, the toast should include brief context. Screen reader users will hear the toast content followed by the action. So "Pinned model reverted. Undo" reads better. Also the action should have `aria-label` like: `aria-label="Undo revert of model pin"`. Marta: Agreed. Small copy examples: Option A (short): "Reverted model pin — Undo" Option B (explicit): "Model pin reverted. Undo" Option C (verbose for SR): include hidden sr-only text: ```
Model pin reverted.
If you do not undo, the previously pinned model will remain unpinned. ``` Alex: I vote Option B + sr-only `aria-label` on the button. Keeps visual UI tidy and reads well. Sam: One more thing — the tooltip icon should have `role="button"` only if it opens a popover. If it's hover-only, keep `role="img"` and `tabindex=0` to allow keyboard reveal. Need a brief doc note. Kevin: I'll add an accessibility checklist item: tooltip trigger must be keyboard focusable, have an accessible name (aria-label or aria-describedby), and any interactive links inside tooltip must be reachable by keyboard. Marta: I'll update the Figma copy and make two variants: short (fits two lines) and expanded (full copy with read-more). Posting the new copy in this thread when ready. :pen: design-bot: Reminder — please include any copy changes in the localization sheet (i18n/copy/console_tooltips.csv) to avoid missing translations. Alex: Thanks all — action items: Marta to push copy variants, Kevin to add dev accessibility notes, Sam/Alex to review implementation in the next sprint. I'll follow up with the exact copy strings. :thumbsup:
